text:
alex: Thinking about a 'short-circuit' auth path for a tiny subset of service accounts (internal telemetry, infra hooks). Drop full project/org lookup and do a signed header check to shave ~25-40ms.
marc: Interesting. Where would we draw the line? sounds risky for billing/quotas.
sophia: Console impact — if we skip project resolution, dashboards will show unattributed spikes. that's a big UX regression.
alex: Goal is only for well-known SAs that are 1) exclusively infra, 2) low-variety usage, 3) pre-approved. fallback to full resolve on mismatch.
niraj: Can we add an attribution header emitted by short-circuit path, e.g., `X-Attribution: org=redwood;project=infra`? then metrics still get bucketed.
marc: But that header could be forged if we accept short-circuit without verifying. need signed token check.
alex: Exactly — plan: require a signed JWT with claim `shortc:true` issued by our internal KMS, verify signature server-side. snippet:

```
Authorization: Bearer <signed-jwt>
Claims: {iss: "auth.redwood", sa: "infra-agent", shortc: true}
```

If valid, skip DB lookup.
sophia: Even with header, we need separate telemetry flag so dashboard knows it's from short-circuit path and not untethered traffic. add `source=shortc` tag.
niraj: Also telemetry sampling — only route 10% through short-circuit in canary and run attribution reconciliation job nightly.
marc: Quota enforcement? If we skip project mapping at enforcement time we may charge the wrong org. maybe we still need to perform quota check against the org in the claim.
alex: We can include `org_id` in the signed claim and enforce against that. adds slight CPU for sig verify but avoids DB hit.
sophia: UX: make the console show an overlay "short-circuit traffic" with explainer. product can decide visibility level.
ops-bot: NOTE: rolling out auth short-circuit to canary (flag: `auth.shortc.v1`) at 2pm UTC. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: deploy triggered for service=auth-gateway, env=canary, sha=abc123
marc: Add telemetry event `auth.shortc.verify` at warn level when claim has mismatched org_id so we can catch forgeries.
niraj: I'll own reconciliation job and dashboard dims (shortc, issuer, sa). I'll mock some data first.
alex: cool. action items: 1) niraj implement reconciliation job, 2) marc add verify+warn, 3) sophia add console overlay copy, 4) ops to run canary and monitor. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident bot: canary alert threshold set: 5% increase in unauth spikes -> rollback.
alex: looping in security for a quick review — @security-team
sophia: thanks, will add to next console sprint item.
